# Ferry Schedule

2026

### Please view our live calendar below for ferry service between Tiburon and Angel Island.
If you have any questions please contact our office staff.

Schedule subject to change without notice. 
Please scroll below calendar to view Return Schedule information

How to book tickets:
Step 1 - Select Date
Step 2 - Select Tiburon Departure Time
Step 3 - Add to Cart
Step 4 - Check out
Note: You do not need to select a return time.
Return times are 20 minutes after each departure time and first come first serve.

### RETURN SCHEDULE

## September 1 - 13, 2026

### **Mondays - Fridays**
Depart TIBURON: 10 am, 11 am, 1 pm, (3 pm – campers only – check return schedule)
Depart Angel Island: 10:20 am, 11:20 am, 1:20 pm, 3:20 pm
Returns are open to all ticket holders

Saturdays/Sundays/Labor Day
Depart TIBURON: 10 am, 11 am, 1 pm, 2 pm, 3 pm, 4 pm, (5 pm – campers only – check return schedule)
Depart Angel Island: 10:20 am, 11:20 am, 1:20 pm, 2:20 pm, 3:20 pm, 4:20 pm, 5:20 pm
Returns are open to all ticket holders
